questions.subject: English Studies
questions.learningObjective: Interpret dialogue and written stage directions in a short dramatic scene.
questions.prompt: What does the instruction in brackets tell the reader? [Sani lowers his voice.] Sani: I found your badge beside the gate.

questions.prompt: In which sentence is the expression “on the fence” used figuratively?

questions.answer: Bisi is on the fence about which club to join.
